subject: Clarifying PO requirement for PilotGate pilot onboarding
messages:
From: Matthew Torres <matthew.torres@pilotgate.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding / PO requirement question

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — PilotGate is excited to kick off the 60-day pilot. We're preparing the onboarding paperwork and have a quick question about billing: does Redwood require a purchase order for a short pilot like this, or can we proceed on an invoice-only basis?

Attached is our draft SOW (PilotGate_SOW_v1.pdf) and the intake form. If a PO is required, let us know the address and the reference lines you prefer. If invoice-only is acceptable, what evidence do you typically need (PO waiver, contract signature, insurance)?

Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Matthew Torres
Head of Partnerships
PilotGate

Attachments: PilotGate_SOW_v1.pdf, Vendor_Intake_Form_PilotGate.xlsx

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Torres <matthew.torres@pilotgate.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding / PO requirement question

Matthew —

Thanks for sending the SOW and intake form. Quick answer: our standard policy is that production subscriptions and multi-month committed contracts need a PO, but for time-limited pilots (usually <=90 days) we can consider invoice-only onboarding provided we get the right evidence.

To move this forward I have looped in Karthik (procurement) and Lauren (finance) to outline the exception path and the checklist we'll need. Preliminary asks from our side:
- Signed SOW (DocuSign link is fine)
- Completed vendor intake form (you already sent this)
- Certificate of insurance or liability waiver if services include data handling
- Invoice remit details and billing contact

Marissa — from a sales perspective, are we okay to accept an invoice-only pilot for PilotGate with the standard 60-day term?

Matthew — I'll let Karthik and Lauren confirm the exact evidence pack. If you can also fill the intake spreadsheet tabs marked "risk" and "remit", that will speed approval.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding / PO requirement question

Folks —

Appreciate the context. We have two parallel lanes: PO lane (default for subscriptions/commits) and short-term invoice lane (for trials, proof-of-value). For PilotGate's 60-day pilot I'd recommend the invoice lane but require the following to mitigate risk:

1) Completed Vendor Intake + W-9 (if US entity)
2) Signed SOW (DocuSign or PDF) that clearly states pilot duration and deliverables
3) Evidence checklist: certificate of insurance OR indemnity letter, customer reference (or GitHub repo if OSS), and remit invoice contact
4) Maximum aggregate exposure capped at $15k without PO (we can set a temporary cap)

I'm attaching our no-po-evidence-checklist.pdf for the cluster of items we ask finance to verify. Once the intake + checklist are in place I can do a procurement sign-off and route to Lauren for finance approval to pay invoice-only.

If PilotGate prefers to issue a PO we can accept PO-to-invoice as usual; PO number can be added to the SOW billing tab. For speed, invoice-only will be faster if PilotGate can supply the checklist items today/tomorrow.

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Matthew Torres <matthew.torres@pilotgate.io>, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@pilotgate.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding / PO requirement question

Quick note — from sales ops perspective we want to keep momentum. Proposal: accept invoice-only for the 60-day pilot on the conditions Karthik listed, and we will commit to converting to a PO-based contract if PilotGate converts to paid subscription within 30 days after pilot end. That gives PilotGate minimal friction now and reduces back-and-forth later.

Lauren — can finance expedite review if Karthik signs the procurement checklist? If there are any additional GL codes or remit fields needed, we can capture them in the intake form and have PilotGate re-submit a single updated spreadsheet to avoid multiple cycles.

Matthew / Sarah — if you can confirm you can provide the COI and signed SOW by tomorrow EOD, we can treat this as "invoice-only pilot approved pending finance" and issue an exception memo that allows processing invoices up to $15k. We'll attach the memo to the vendor record.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
